description: Modern asymmetric grid of feature tiles with varying sizes. 2024-2026 popular layout. Strongest when you have 5-8 features with mixed prominence (some warrant a bigger tile). Skip if all features feel equal — use Features3Col instead.

tiles.hint: 5-9 tiles. Each: { title, description?, icon?, image?: { src, alt? }, cta?, size? (default/wide/tall/feature), tone? (default/tinted/accent/dark) }. Mix sizes for visual rhythm — typically 1 'feature' tile, 1-2 'tall' or 'wide', rest 'default'. Total column units should add up cleanly (6-column grid).
